name: Bureau Veritas SA

corporate_actions.event: Wendel sold down: prepaid 3-year forward sale of ~6.7% of capital (~EUR750m) and 23.3m shares via exchangeable (~EUR591m). Remaining stake not stated (ESTIMATE ~14-16%, from ~26.5% prior holding per recall).
Reporting re-segmented from six to four lines; planned exits of Oil & Petrochemicals, Coal testing & inspection and Government Services
CMD: LEAP|28 confirmed; total revenue growth target upgraded to double-digit CAGR 2027-28
Merger talks with SGS confirmed then terminated (recall)

geography.fx_notes: Not extracted. INFERENCE (recall): Europe ~33% (France ~12-14%), Americas ~30% (US ~15%), Asia-Pacific ~28% (China ~8-10%), Africa/Middle East ~9%; EM share high (~45-50%).

kpis.name: Organic by business Q3-26
kpis.value: Buildings & Infrastructure +7.9%; Product Testing & Services +7.0%; Industrials & Commodities +5.1%; Business Assurance +3.2%

kpis.name: End-market note
kpis.value: Marine & Offshore +14.3% organic FY25; APAC +8.2%; food testing divested

kpis.name: Accreditation / capex
kpis.value: Accredited labs and notified-body status (structural); capex % not extracted

company_fcf.definition: Company free cash flow (OCF after tax, interest and capex)

acquisitions.notes: Bolt-ons in B&I/energy transition and cybersecurity under LEAP|28; scope +1.8% Q3-26; portfolio exits (food, O&P, coal, government services)

management.guidance_record: Good: FY25 sector-leading organic; FY26 guidance confirmed at Q3 (one secondary report of softer wording, unverified)

ownership.controlling_holders: Wendel (reference shareholder, reduced to ESTIMATE ~14-16% after 2025 sales); free float majority

guidance.value: Mid-to-high single-digit organic growth; adjusted operating margin improvement at constant FX; strong cash generation

evidence: Regulation-driven inspection (B&I, marine class, in-service inspection) recurring
A.rationale: Largely recurring compliance work with some commodity/oil cyclicality.

evidence: Global top-3 TIC; sector-leading organic 6.5% FY25 vs SGS 5.6%
Energy transition, cybersecurity, supply-chain compliance; double-digit total growth target
Portfolio pruning; EUR200m buyback; leverage ~1.7x provider
Wendel reference stake declining; more free float
Physical inspection resilient; certification/audit (Business Assurance +3.2%) and report-writing more automatable
Large inspector/back-office cost base; remote inspection, AI report generation
Time-and-material billing in parts of inspection
Labour cost passed via pricing; regulatory demand

ai.notes: AI is both a productivity tool and a threat to desk-based certification.

gates.notes: Provider ND/EBITDA 1.7x. FCF EUR824m vs NI ~EUR600m (>100%). No Chinese domicile (China operating exposure ~8-10% ESTIMATE). Wendel sell-down is overhang, not G6.

bull_points: Sector-leading organic growth (6-10%) with rising margins and >100% cash conversion.
Portfolio reshaped toward B&I, energy transition and product testing; double-digit total growth target.
Wendel exit increases free float/index weight.
bear_points: High EM/China exposure and commodity/oil sensitivity in I&C.
Business Assurance (certification) growth slow and exposed to AI/digital audit.
Wendel forward-sale overhang; M&A acceleration may dilute returns.
thesis_breakers: Cash conversion below 90% for two years.
